description: Proposes that two exports (artifacts) contain the same chatbot conversation: identical thread_id and chatbot on chat_message events of different artifacts. If a logical-record table from the importer track exists, its presence is reported; its columns are not interpreted by this rule version.

right.selector: another artifact containing the same thread_id

criteria.shared_external_ids: evidence: count of external_id values present in both artifacts
criteria.message_counts: evidence: messages per artifact and first/last display times
